summary.zh: 官方 Python SDK（pip 包 typesafe-sdk，要求 Python ≥ 3.10），提供同步/异步客户端与 Choice/Score/Noul 类型，默认读取 TYPESAFE_API_KEY。
summary.en: Official Python SDK (pip package typesafe-sdk, Python >= 3.10) with sync/async clients and Choice/Score/Noul types; reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY by default.

summary.zh: 官方 TypeScript/JavaScript SDK（npm 包 @typesafe-ai/sdk），答案类型可自动推断，内置重试与错误分类。
summary.en: Official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (npm package @typesafe-ai/sdk) with inferred answer types, built-in retries and error classes.

summary.zh: 官方 Agent Skill：教 Claude Code、Codex 等编码助手正确调用 System One API 的技能包。
summary.en: Official agent skills teaching coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex how to call the System One API.

summary.zh: 官方适配器：用普通 LLM API 模拟 TypeSafeClient，便于对照测试或降级运行。
summary.en: Official adapter that emulates TypeSafeClient on top of ordinary LLM APIs for A/B testing or fallback.

summary.zh: Browser Use 出品的极速网页 Agent：Jev 负责选择操作与目标元素，小模型只在需要打字时介入。发布首周星数最高的 Jev 项目。
summary.en: Browser Use's fast web agent: Jev picks each action and target element while a small LLM only types when needed. The most-starred Jev project of launch week.

summary.zh: 基于 Jev 的浏览器自动化实现。
summary.en: Browser automation driven by Jev.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：用 Jev 逐条判断历史工具调用的去留，替代摘要式上下文压缩；保留的内容原样保留。社区对该策略存在争议。
summary.en: Claude Code plugin that replaces compaction summaries with Jev decisions on every past tool call; kept content stays verbatim. The approach is debated in the community.

summary.zh: Claude Code 插件：按任务选择最便宜且够用的模型。
summary.en: Claude Code plugin that routes each task to the cheapest sufficient model.

summary.zh: 分阶段代码审查流程与本地面板。
summary.en: A staged code-review workflow with a local dashboard.

summary.zh: MCP 服务器：把校验、筛选、排序等判断暴露为 Agent 可调用的工具。
summary.en: MCP server exposing typed judgments (screening, filtering, ranking) as agent tools.

summary.zh: MCP 连接器：让 Agent 直接调用 Jev。
summary.en: MCP connector giving agents direct access to Jev.

summary.zh: 编码 Agent 的安全闸门：对每次工具调用给出 deny/ask/allow 风险判断，并标记提示注入；支持多种编码助手。
summary.en: A safety gate for coding agents: risk-scores every tool call as deny/ask/allow and flags prompt injection across many coding assistants.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 审查 Agent Skill 与 MCP 代码中的可疑行为（中文说明项目）。
summary.en: Reviews agent skills and MCP code for suspicious behavior using Jev (Chinese-language project).

summary.zh: 受 Jev 启发的开源实现：在开源模型上复刻“语义 if”接口，3090 显卡可本地运行。原名 OpenJev，作者声明与 TypeSafe 无关；不是 Jev 权重开源。
summary.en: An inspired open-source reimplementation of the 'semantic if' interface on open models, runnable on a single RTX 3090. Formerly OpenJev; the author states it is independent of TypeSafe. Not the Jev weights.

summary.zh: 基于 Qwen3.5 的迷你 Jev 式决策模型，可自行训练并在本机运行。
summary.en: A tiny Jev-like decision-model family built on Qwen3.5 that you can train and run yourself.

summary.zh: 0.6B 参数的 Jev 复刻：并行决策、动态候选与端到端训练流程。社区项目，与官方无关。
summary.en: A 0.6B-parameter Jev replica with parallel decisions, dynamic candidates, and an end-to-end training pipeline. Community project, unrelated to TypeSafe.

summary.zh: PostgreSQL 扩展：用自然语言对表格行做判断。许可证未被 GitHub 识别为标准开源协议。
summary.en: A PostgreSQL extension for asking plain-language questions over table rows. Its license is not recognized by GitHub as a standard open-source license.

summary.zh: LlamaIndex 出品：用 Jev 做快速文档分类与子文档边界识别。
summary.en: From LlamaIndex: fast document classification and sub-document boundary detection with Jev.

summary.zh: Hono 中间件：按语义把请求路由到不同处理器。
summary.en: Hono middleware that routes HTTP requests by meaning.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 选择数据源、理解查询并按相关性排序的网页搜索（基于 Search1API）。
summary.en: Web search where Jev picks sources, interprets queries, and ranks relevance (built on Search1API).

summary.zh: 用人工反馈与 GEPA 校准 Jev 判断函数。
summary.en: Calibrates Jev judgment functions from human feedback using GEPA.

summary.zh: 在 Monad 链上每个区块做一次买卖判断（默认 dry-run 模拟）。仅供研究，不构成任何投资建议；实盘风险自担。
summary.en: Makes one buy/sell decision per Monad block (dry-run by default). Research only — not investment advice; live trading carries real risk.

summary.zh: 英文精选清单，按 13 类收录数百个项目与讨论；作者提醒同日批量提交的项目未经验证。
summary.en: A curated English list of hundreds of projects and discussions across 13 categories; the author warns that same-day batch submissions are unvetted.

summary.zh: 中文精选列表：官方资料、应用、Agent 工具与开源复现，附中文上手指南。
summary.en: A Chinese curated list of official resources, apps, agent tooling, and replicas, with a Chinese quick-start guide.

summary.zh: 用 Jev 筛选历史 Hacker News 评论中的可核验预测；仓库包含预注册试验、实际调用代码和作者发布的结果数据，尚未处理完整档案。
summary.en: Screens historical Hacker News comments for checkable predictions with Jev; includes a preregistered pilot, calling code and author-published results, but not a completed full-archive run.

summary.zh: Rust 代码审查工具：解析源码后向 Jev 提交局部、类型化的维护性判断，并由代码汇成带位置和建议的发现；安全规则需另行启用。
summary.en: Rust code-review tool that asks Jev typed questions about parsed source units, then composes located findings and suggested actions; security rules are opt-in.

summary.zh: pi 的浏览器与 macOS 桌面 Agent 扩展：Jev 根据可见文本、控件和目标选择单步动作，执行循环设有步数和人工复核边界。
summary.en: A pi browser and macOS desktop agent extension: Jev chooses one action from visible text, controls and the goal, within a bounded loop with human-review gates.
